reviews.body: AI-assisted release review requested by Ashira. I checked the exact staging head against main and verified the CI and deployment-check jobs passed. The change maps only Express's `entity.too.large` error to HTTP 413. The regression covers the 102400-byte validation control, the 102401-byte rejection, malformed JSON at 400, and health after rejection. The release diff contains no migration or seed changes. Merge is pending coordination with ClassPulse. Their independent retest and acceptance are still pending.
